title: 第二十四章 低武世界第二十五章 江湖传闻
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
兽皮上记载的是一段段首尾不相连的诗歌，前后矛盾，看的林阳蹙眉。怪不得这方圆得到许久也未曾破解，这玩意除了智慧通天之辈想来也无人可以看懂。
欧阳意渴望的看着那一张兽皮，上面有关于《御神策》的线索，能让人成为武之神者。
可叹，此道人非人哉。
他心中涌起阵阵无力，接着他便听到了玄袍道人淡漠而又高远的话语：“你乃朝廷中人？”
“这位道长，我是‘护龙阁’四阁主。‘护龙阁’是圣上的直属组织，负责处理种种和圣上密切相关的事宜。”
欧阳意如实禀报，他说的这些在江湖上随便就能打听得到，倒也无需欺骗。
“看你这次前来夺取神功线索，想来你等早有准备将其破解。”林阳将手中兽皮抛给欧阳意，继续道：“无论你等获得此功后想要做些什么，都和我无关，十四日后我会上门取走神功，届时你等要无法获得《御神策》，休怪我心狠手辣。”
欧阳意心中又喜又怒，这玄袍道人实在狂妄至极，仗着自身武功奇高，就可以不将护龙阁，不将朝廷放在眼中？看他还需要《御神策》显然并非武之神者，顶破天又是一位大宗师罢了，届时真敢上门，必会在大军围剿下死无葬身之地。
“前辈不可，朝廷之人……”
脸色大变的方圆话语还未说完，便看见天空徒然乌云滚滚，雷电翻腾，眼前的玄袍道人身形变得无比高大威严，似是执掌雷霆的神祗，不可直视。
“啊！”
一道闪电劈落，烈焰焚身，刻苦铭心的疼痛使得方圆发出一声凄厉至极的惨叫。
“何时有你插嘴余地。”
林阳淡然的话语传入精神萎靡的方圆耳中，使得他内心恐惧难言。
平时倒也罢了，但此时事关主线任务，哪怕善功对他来说不多，也容不得旁人打扰，这是态度问题。
刚刚的一切不过是精神压制下的种种幻象，使得欧阳意看的莫名其妙，摸不着头脑。只能猜测这通州第一高手是被玄袍道人用莫测手段教训了一番。
“希望我的话你可以如实转达给你的上级。免得到时做出无谓的举动。”说完刚准备离开，林阳又接着道：“寻常武林秘籍无论一流还是三流，多多益善，如果我满意到时候少不了你们好处。”
这时，他心神呼应煌劫刀，借宝兵之力勾连天地雷火之力，整个人化作一道雷光破空离开。徒留庄园内二人看着眼前的一切目瞪口呆。
“飞天遁地……这是真正的飞天遁地！”
精神受创后萎靡不振的方圆瞪大眼睛看着林阳离去的方向，没想到竟然见识到了武林中千百年难出一位的武之神者。

猛然间，心头传来警兆，他大呼不妙就要避开。然而早就不复巅峰状态的方圆力不从心，被欧阳意一掌击中心口处，掌中螺旋劲力吞吐，将方圆的心脏绞得粉碎。
“武之神者？”
欧阳意扔掉死不瞑目的方圆，望着天边喃喃自语。
……
借用宝兵之力哪怕以林阳现在的境界也难以持久，他飞遁数百里便在一座繁华城池外降下身形，准备这十来天好好地游玩一番。
content_en:
What was written on the animal skin was a piece of unconnected poetry, so inconsistent that Lin Yang frowned. No wonder this Fang Yuan has not been cracked for a long time. No one can understand this thing except for those who are extremely intelligent.
Ouyang Yi looked at the animal skin longingly. There were clues about the "God Control Strategy" on it, which could make people become the God of Martial Arts.
It's a pity that this Taoist is not a human being.
He felt helpless in his heart, and then he heard the indifferent and lofty words of Taoist Xuanpao: "Are you from the imperial court?"
"This Taoist Priest, I am the fourth pavilion master of the 'Dragon Protection Pavilion'. The 'Dragon Protection Pavilion' is an organization directly under the Holy Lord and is responsible for handling various matters closely related to the Holy Lord."
Ouyang Yi reported truthfully. What he said could be easily obtained by asking around the world, so there was no need to deceive.
"Seeing that you came here to seize the clues to the magical skill, I think you have been prepared to crack it." Lin Yang threw the animal skin in his hand to Ouyang Yi and continued: "No matter what you want to do after you obtain this skill, it has nothing to do with me. I will come to take away the magical skill in fourteen days. If you can't get the "God Control Strategy" by then, don't blame me for being cruel."
Ouyang Yi felt happy and angry at the same time. This Xuanpao Taoist was really arrogant. How could he ignore the Dragon Protection Pavilion and the imperial court by relying on his extraordinary martial arts skills? Seeing that he still needs "Yu Shen Ce", he is obviously not a god of martial arts, but a great master of Ding Po Tian. If he really dares to come to the door, he will definitely die without a burial place under the encirclement and suppression of the army.
"Senior, not allowed, people from the imperial court..."
Before Fangyuan, whose face changed greatly, could finish his words, he saw dark clouds rolling in the sky and thunder and lightning. The figure of the Xuanpao Taoist in front of him became extremely tall and majestic. He seemed to be a god in charge of thunder and could not be looked directly at.
"Ah!"
A bolt of lightning struck down, burning his body in flames, and the unforgettable pain made Fang Yuan let out a shrill scream.
"When do you have room to interrupt?"
Lin Yang's calm words reached the ears of the depressed Fangyuan, making him feel unspeakable fear in his heart.
Normally that would be fine, but at this time it was related to the main task. Even if his good deeds were not many, he would not allow others to disturb him. This was a matter of attitude.
Everything just happened was just various illusions under mental suppression, which made Ouyang Yi feel confused and confused. We can only guess that the top master in Tongzhou was taught a lesson by Taoist Xuanpao using unpredictable means.
"I hope you can convey my words to your superiors truthfully. So as not to make unnecessary moves later." After finishing speaking, Lin Yang was about to leave, and then continued: "Whether ordinary martial arts secrets are first-rate or third-rate, the more the better. If I am satisfied, you will benefit from it."
At this time, his mind responded to the Huang Jie Dao, using the power of the treasure weapon to connect with the power of thunder and fire from heaven and earth, and his whole body turned into a bolt of thunder and left through the air. The two people in Tuliu Manor were stunned at what they saw.
"Flying to the sky and the earth...this is the real flying to the sky and the earth!"
Fang Yuan, who was depressed after being mentally traumatized, stared at the direction Lin Yang left with wide eyes. Unexpectedly, he saw a god of martial arts who had rarely been seen in the martial arts for thousands of years.
Suddenly, there was a warning sign in his heart, and he shouted that something was wrong and he had to avoid it. However, Fangyuan, who had long since lost his peak state, was unable to do what he wanted. Ouyang Yi struck him in the center of his mouth with a palm, and the spiral force in his palm was swallowed up, twisting Fangyuan's heart into pieces.
"The God of Martial Arts?"
Ouyang Yi threw away Fang Yuan, looking at the horizon and muttering to himself.
…
Even with Lin Yang's current state, it would be difficult to use the power of the treasure weapon for a long time. He flew hundreds of miles and landed outside a prosperous city, preparing to have a good time in the past ten days.
